label: #3637163: Custom accent color field lacks validation, pinned core
description: Authoring comparison, no merge request yet. Before is unmodified core. After adds a lab-authored Phase 1 fix: the live preview of the custom Accent and Focus colours is applied only when the value is a valid six-digit hex colour, the Form API rejects invalid values on save, and stored invalid values fail safely when rendered. Plain Standard install (Default Admin is the admin theme).
status: DRAFT: lab-authored proposal (no merge request); human review required

steps.text: Use a plain Standard install (Default Admin is the admin theme). Log in to both sites and open /admin/appearance/settings/default_admin. Choose the last Accent color swatch, Custom, so the Custom Accent color text field is shown.
steps.lookFor: A text field with the placeholder #777777 and a colour picker next to it.

steps.text: Type an invalid value into the Custom Accent color field (for example 777777 without the #, or #zzzzzz) and press Tab to leave the field.
steps.lookFor: Before: the interface colours turn black or invisible (Save button, Appearance state, toggles) as soon as the field loses focus. After: the interface keeps its last valid colour and the field shows an actionable error.

steps.text: Repeat for the Custom Focus color field (set Focus color to Custom, enter an invalid value, press Tab to leave the field), then press Tab through the page.
steps.lookFor: Before: keyboard focus indicators can become invisible. After: the last valid focus colour stays in use.

steps.text: Enter a valid value (#336699) and save. Then try to save an invalid value with the browser's own validation bypassed (the viewer's tools, or the evaluate script).
steps.lookFor: Valid value saves and applies. Invalid value is rejected by the server on After with a message naming the field; Before it is accepted and stored.

expected: An invalid custom accent or focus colour never changes the live styling, is rejected on save, and the last valid colour stays in use.
actual: Before: the invalid text is written to --accent-base (or to the custom focus style) when the field loses focus, so controls and text can become invisible; the browser-only pattern attribute does not stop the preview or a submit that bypasses it.

checks.label: Settings form has the Custom Accent color field
Settings form has the Custom Focus color field
The custom accent field is described by text that names the hexadecimal format
The active accent color on the page is a valid six-digit hex value

observe.label: After typing an invalid Custom Accent value and leaving the field, are the Save button and Appearance labels still visible?
Is an error message shown on the field that says what format is accepted?
Does a valid hex colour still change the preview, and does the picker still sync with the text field?
With an invalid Custom Focus value, is the keyboard focus indicator still visible on the page?

coverage.note: The combinations that count as tested for this issue (scripts/coverage.mjs). Edit to fit the question the issue asks.
